summary: Iteration 41 - Video Call Auto-Detect, SIP Indicators, SIP-Only Mode Testing Complete. All features verified: (1) Video call auto-detect on answer works - answerCall uses isVideoCall = withVideo || incomingCall.call_type === 'video', (2) Remote video element always mounted in CallInterface with hidden class when no streams, (3) Dialer shows WebRTC label with gray dot for contacts without extensions, (4) SIP Only toggle present in PBX form with '(no ICE/STUN)' label, (5) sipService.js uses empty iceServers when sip_only=true, (6) Backend sip_only field added to PbxConfigCreate model and sip-credentials endpoint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 41 verified video call auto-detect, SIP indicators, and SIP-only mode. The SIP registration shows 'Connecting...' because the real PBX WebSocket (wss://23317.hpbx.outboundproxy.com:443) is not reachable from preview environment - this is expected. WebRTC fallback works for internal calls. Blue SIP dot only shows when sipRegistered=true AND contact has extension. Currently only admin has extension 2450, so other contacts show gray dot with 'WebRTC' label.
